name: Mainframe Escape
summary:
You're a process stuck on a machine that's been infected for years. The only way out is down.

Mainframe Escape is a twin stick roguelite set inside a computer. The floors are circuit boards, the walls are heatsinks, and everything trying to kill you is malware. You're a CPU die with a gun. The whole thing runs on heat: shooting heats you up, and between 70 and 99 percent you deal 30% more damage, but hit 100 and your weapon locks out. Every component you pick up draws power and only a PSU gives any back, and components change what your bullets actually do instead of just making numbers bigger.
